name: What is a P-trap and how does it prevent sewage smells?

mainEntity.name: What is a P-trap and how does it prevent sewage smells?

acceptedAnswer.text: A P-trap is a U-shaped bend in your drainpipe, typically found under sinks, showers, and toilets. Its design allows it to hold a small amount of water, creating a seal that blocks noxious sewer gases from rising into your home. If a P-trap dries out due to infrequent use or evaporation, this water seal breaks, allowing odors to escape. Ensuring your P-traps remain filled with water is a simple preventative measure.
acceptedAnswer.description: A P-trap is a U-shaped drainpipe section that holds water, forming a seal to block sewer gases from entering your home.
